terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms explain how the platform works and what we expect from everyone who uses it.

sections.heading: What the platform does
sections.body: Al-Malab helps people find and organize recreational football: matches, teams, opponents, venues and tournaments. Organizers, teams and venues are responsible for the games and facilities they list. We provide tools; we don't run the matches or the venues.

sections.heading: Your account
sections.body: Use your real availability and act in good faith. Keep your password private. You must be old enough to agree to these terms in your country. One person, one account.

sections.heading: Listings and bookings
sections.body: Listings must be real. Venue bookings are only confirmed when the venue (or its automatic confirmation) accepts them in the app. A match being full does not mean a pitch is booked. Venues set their own prices, opening hours and cancellation rules.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.body: The platform does not process payments at this time. Costs shown are shares calculated from what organizers and venues enter, and are settled directly between people. Never send money to someone you don't trust.

sections.heading: Conduct
sections.body: No harassment, discrimination, threats, spam, fake listings or fraudulent bookings. Moderators may hide content and suspend accounts that break these rules.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms as the product evolves. Important changes will be announced in the app.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: We collect only what's needed to run the service and we don't sell personal data.

sections.heading: What we store
sections.body: Your e-mail address (private), display name, optional photo, city, optional public neighborhood, playing preferences, the matches, teams and bookings you take part in, messages you send, and reviews and reports you submit.

sections.heading: What others can see
sections.body: Your display name, photo, city, the neighborhood you chose to show, positions, self-reported level and teams. Your match history and statistics are public only if you allow it. Your e-mail is never shown. We never show precise locations.

sections.heading: Location
sections.body: We only ask for your browser location when you tap 'Near me'. The coordinates are rounded, used for that search, and not stored.

sections.heading: Messages
sections.body: Conversations are visible only to their participants. Moderators can see a copy of a message only when it is reported.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can edit your profile, hide your match history, mute optional notifications and block people at any time. To delete your account, contact support; we will remove your personal data except where we must keep records (e.g. moderation decisions).

safety.title: Trust & safety
safety.intro: Football should be fun and safe. Here is how the platform protects players and venues.

sections.heading: Verified venues
sections.body: Venues are checked by our team before they can take bookings through the app. Unverified venues are shown as contact-only.

sections.heading: Honest information
sections.body: Skill levels are self-reported and labelled that way. Ratings appear only after several reviews, and only people who actually played together can review each other.

sections.heading: Report and block
sections.body: Every profile, listing, review and message has a report option. Blocking someone stops direct messages and prevents them joining matches you organize.

sections.heading: Meeting in person
sections.body: Meet at the venue, play in public places, and keep personal details private until you're comfortable. Don't share payment information in chat.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.body: There are no in-app payments yet. Pay organizers or venues in person and be wary of anyone asking for money in advance outside the agreed arrangement.

teamForm.visibilityHint: Private teams are hidden from search; players join by invitation.

teamPage.recordNote: Only team-vs-team results confirmed by the opposing team are counted.
teamPage.needed: {count, plural, one {# player needed} other {# players needed}}
teamPage.messagePlaceholder: Say a few words about yourself (optional)
teamPage.requestPending: Your request to join is waiting for the team managers.
teamPage.leaveDescription: You'll lose access to the team chat.
teamPage.leaveCaptain: Captains must hand over captaincy first, unless they're the last member (the team is then archived).

teamManage.title: Manage {name}
teamManage.captainNote: Making someone captain transfers captaincy; you become a manager.
teamManage.recruitTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Goalkeeper needed for Friday nights
teamManage.logoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
teamManage.archiveDescription: The team is hidden from search, open listings close and pending invitations are revoked.

recruitment.title: Teams recruiting
recruitment.description: Teams looking for players, by position.
recruitment.empty: No open recruitment listings right now.

opponents.title: Find opponents
opponents.description: Publish when your team wants a game, or challenge a team that's looking.
opponents.needTeamBody: Only team captains and managers can publish requests or send challenges.
opponents.noOpenRequestsBody: Publish your own request below and other teams can challenge you.

player.statsNote: Recorded by organizers; {verified, plural, =0 {no results} one {# result} other {# results}} confirmed by an opposing team. Disputed results are excluded.
player.statsHidden: This player keeps their statistics private.
player.notEnoughReviews: Ratings appear after a few reviews ({count} so far).
player.attendance: Attendance recorded by organizers: {noShows} no-shows in {marked} matches; {late} late withdrawals.
player.reliabilityNote: Ratings come only from people who played together. They reflect conduct, not football skill.

settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteNote: To delete your account and personal data, contact support. Some records (such as moderation decisions) may be kept as required.
settings.notificationsHint: Notifications about commitments you've made (cancellations, changes, bookings, promotions) are always sent.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Match, team, booking and direct conversations.
messages.emptyBody: Chats appear here once someone writes in a match, team or booking you're part of.
messages.deleteBody: It's deleted for everyone and shows as “Message deleted”. This can't be undone.
messages.lockedNote: This conversation is read-only because the match was cancelled.
messages.safetyNote: Never share passwords or payment details in chat. Use the report button on any message that breaks the rules.
messages.locationImproving: Accuracy improves over a few seconds, and is better in the open.
messages.locationDenied: The site isn't allowed to see your location. Allow it in your browser settings, then try again.
messages.locationFailed: Couldn't find your location. Check location services are on, then try again.
messages.locationUnsupported: Your browser can't share a location.
messages.micDenied: The microphone isn't allowed. Allow it in your browser settings, then try again.

venues.title: Venues
venues.description: Search by the venue's name, and book your time here.
venues.bookDescription: Pick a venue, then the day and time.
venues.emptySearchBody: Check the spelling, or try part of the name.
venues.emptyBody: Venue owners can list their pitches for free.

venuePage.contactTitle: Bookings are arranged directly with this venue
venuePage.contactBody: This venue doesn't take bookings through the app. Contact it using the details on this page — the platform cannot confirm availability for it.
venuePage.noFields: The owner hasn't added the court's details yet.
venuePage.noMatches: No upcoming public matches at this venue.
venuePage.cancellationDeadline: Free cancellation until {hours} hours before the booking.
venuePage.autoConfirm: Requests are confirmed automatically if the slot is free.
venuePage.depositPolicy: Bookings are confirmed by a {amount} deposit, sent to the venue within {minutes} minutes of booking. If you cancel it isn't refunded; if the venue cancels it's returned.
venuePage.cancellationDeadlineDeposit: You can cancel until {hours} hours before the booking.
venuePage.notBookableBody: Bookings happen on the site only. Booking opens on this page once our team has verified the venue and the venue has said how to pay the deposit.

venueForm.name: Venue name
venueForm.coordsHint: Optional. Copy from a map app; used for directions and distance.
venueForm.phoneHint: Not shown to customers: bookings happen on the site, and you talk with customers in each booking's conversation.
venueForm.verificationRequired: Booking on the site opens once our team has verified the venue. You can prepare the settings now.
venueForm.modePlatform: Accept booking requests in the app
venueForm.bufferHint: Cleaning/changeover time blocked after each booking.
venueForm.autoConfirm: Confirm requests automatically when the slot is free and no deposit is due
venueForm.bookingInSite: Bookings happen on the site only: customers book from the venue page, and requests reach you under Bookings here. Only you and your staff see them.
venueForm.courts: How many courts does your venue have?
venueForm.courtsSeveralHint: You'll add the courts after creating the venue, each with its name and price. Customers pick the court when they book.

venueDashboard.title: Venue dashboard
venueDashboard.description: Manage your venues, their courts, hours and bookings.
venueDashboard.emptyBody: List your pitch to appear in the venue directory. After verification you can accept bookings.
venueDashboard.newDescription: Start with the basics: name, place and how many courts. You'll add opening hours and photos next.
venueDashboard.ownershipNote: Only list venues you own or are authorized to manage. Our team verifies venues before they can take bookings.
venueDashboard.verificationExplain: Verification confirms the venue is real and run by you. Until then it is listed as contact-only.
venueDashboard.manualBooking: Record a booking or block time
venueDashboard.pricingHint: Rules override the base price for bookings that start on the chosen days within the time range (e.g. evening peak). Leave a rule's price empty to remove it.
venueDashboard.hoursHint: Untick a day to mark it closed. A closing time earlier than the opening time means the venue closes after midnight.
venueDashboard.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
venueDashboard.staffRoles: Managers can edit the venue and handle bookings. Staff can only handle bookings.

stat.valueHint: Based on prices of bookings; not payments received.

venueDashboard.depositHint: Shown to customers when they book: where to send the {amount} deposit (for example your ZainCash or AsiaHawala number), or that they can pay it at your desk.
venueDashboard.hoursMissingTitle: Customers can't book until you set your opening hours
venueDashboard.hoursMissingBody: Bookings are only within opening hours, and this venue's haven't been set yet.
venueDashboard.depositMissingTitle: Customers can't book until you add your deposit payment details
venueDashboard.depositMissingBody: Every booking is confirmed by a {amount} deposit paid to you. Tell customers where to send it.
venueDashboard.platformNote: You handle this venue's bookings with its admins' powers, as part of the platform team. The venue's settings (pitches, prices, hours, staff) stay with its owners.
venueDashboard.moreCourts: I have more than one court
venueDashboard.moreCourtsHint: Add each court with its name and price. Once your venue has more than one, customers pick the court when they book.
venueDashboard.firstCourtHint: Add your courts one by one, each with its name and price. Customers pick the court when they book.

booking.title: Book {name}
booking.description: Pick a court, a day and a duration, then one of the free times.
booking.forMatch: This booking will be linked to your match once requested.
booking.notBookableTitle: This venue can't be booked yet
booking.notBookableBody: Booking opens here once our team has verified the venue and the venue has said how to pay the deposit.
booking.noHoursTitle: This venue hasn't set its opening hours yet
booking.noHoursBody: Bookings are only within opening hours, so you can't book here until the venue says when it opens and closes.
booking.pendingLimitTitle: You have {count} booking requests still waiting for an answer, the most allowed
booking.pendingLimitBody: Wait for the venue to answer one, or cancel a request you no longer need in My bookings, then book.
booking.freeNone: No free time that day for this duration. Try another day or a shorter duration.
booking.freeHint: Pick a start time to see the price and book.

conflict.mine: You already have a booking at this time on this court.
conflict.held: Another customer is holding this time until they send the deposit, until {time} at the latest. If they don't, it becomes free again.
conflict.heldReported: Another customer is holding this time: they've sent the deposit and are waiting for the venue to confirm it.
conflict.closed: The venue has closed this time.
conflict.gap: The venue keeps {minutes} minutes between bookings, and this time is too close to another booking.

booking.pickFree: Pick one of the free times above.
booking.autoConfirmNote: This venue confirms automatically if the slot is still free when you submit.
booking.requestNote: The venue will confirm or decline your request. Unanswered requests expire.
booking.paymentNote: Pay the venue directly. No payment is taken in the app.
booking.noticeRule: Book at least {minutes} minutes ahead and up to {days} days ahead.
booking.depositNote: Booking holds this time for you for {minutes} minutes. Send the deposit to the venue in that time and tell us here; the venue confirms once it sees it.
booking.depositPolicy: If you cancel, the deposit isn't refunded. If the venue cancels, it returns it.
booking.cancellationRuleDeposit: You can cancel until {hours} hours before; the deposit isn't refunded.
booking.descriptionOne: Pick a day and a duration, then one of the free times.

bookings.mineDescription: Requests and confirmed bookings you've made.
bookings.noneMine: You haven't made any bookings yet.
bookings.slotTaken: Declined automatically: the slot was confirmed for another booking.
bookings.cancelCustomerNote: The venue will be notified. After the cancellation deadline you'll need to contact the venue.
bookings.sendBy: Send it by {time}, or the time is released.
bookings.referenceLabel: How can the venue recognise your transfer?
bookings.referenceHint: For example the number you sent from, or the transfer code.
bookings.reported: You told the venue it's sent (“{reference}”). Your time stays held until they confirm.
bookings.depositMissingNote: The booking is declined and the time is freed. The customer is told.
bookings.depositNotReceivedNote: Declined: the venue says the deposit didn't arrive.
bookings.depositExpiredNote: Released: the deposit wasn't confirmed in time.
bookings.cancelForfeitNote: The venue will be notified, and your {amount} deposit won't be refunded.
bookings.cancelStaffRefundNote: The customer will be notified, and the {amount} deposit must be returned to them.

calendar.title: Pitch booking: {venue}
calendar.pending: Waiting for the venue to confirm.
calendar.heldTitle: The time is held for you
calendar.promptBody: Add it to your calendar for a reminder two hours before.

stage.resetBall: Bring the ball back to the centre spot

matches.title: Matches looking for players.
matches.body: Straight from their organisers: when and where, the format, the price — and how many spots are still open.
matches.spotsLeft: {count, plural, one {# spot left} other {# spots left}}
matches.emptyBody: Be the first: create a match and players will find you.

squad.title: Build your squad, position by position.
squad.body: Teams post the positions they are missing. Find the one that fits you, or recruit the players your team needs.
squad.teamsLooking: {count, plural, one {# team looking} other {# teams looking}}

venues.title: Find your pitch.
venues.body: Compare prices and formats. Verified venues take booking requests in the app; the others list how to reach them.
venues.emptyBody: Venue owners can list their pitches for free.

tournaments.title: When the lights stay on longer.
tournaments.body: Register your team, then follow the fixtures, results and standings.
tournaments.emptyTitle: No tournaments are running right now
tournaments.emptyBody: Organise one: set the format, open registration and publish the fixtures.

trust.verified: Venues are verified by our team before they can take bookings.
trust.reviews: Reviews only come from people who actually played together.
trust.privacy: Your exact location and contact details are never shown publicly.
trust.payments: No online payments yet — costs are settled in person and nothing is charged through the app.

calls.ringsWhereOpen: It rings if they have the site open; otherwise they get a missed-call notification.

note.failed: Couldn't connect the call. Try another network (Wi-Fi, for example), then call again.
note.micDenied: Allow the microphone in your browser settings to make calls.
note.unsupported: Your browser can't make voice calls.
note.rateLimited: You've called a lot in a short time. Wait a little, then try again.

calls.speaker: Speaker

speakerNote.unsupported: This phone's browser doesn't let the site switch the speaker. On iPhone it needs iOS 18.4 or later, in Safari.
speakerNote.otherBrowser: On iPhone, switching between speaker and earpiece works in Safari (iOS 18.4 or later). If the sound didn't move here, open the site in Safari.
speakerNote.headset: The sound is in the headphones connected to the phone.
speakerNote.failed: The phone didn't switch the speaker. Try again.
